title: Delete Old Rust Incremental Caches
description: Free disk space by deleting every superseded Rust incremental compilation session under the shared Cargo stores, keeping the newest finalized session and any in-progress working session for each crate.
summary: Removed idle Rust incremental crates (5.58 GiB) and 70-hour-old Cargo intermediate build directories (26.78 GiB). Data volume free space rose from 23 GiB to 54 GiB.
